scientific_integrity: Linear-order cutoff and carousel construction are attributed to prior work; the theorem claims the exact logical transfer for the unlabelled tournament family, not those ingredients.
scientific_limitations: Only pure-arc first-order logic and carousel tournaments on at least three vertices; all-ranks result follows from the proof, with finite testing only as corroboration. Historical completeness and independent validation are not claimed.
title: Exact quantifier-rank shift for finite carousel tournaments
